pages.text: $(bold)The End portal needs sixteen $(thing)different$(n) eyes. None can be crafted or mined.$(br2)Each is a node on the last ring, behind the final seal.
pages.title: IV. The Sixteen Eyes
Where They Come From
pages.text: $(bold)$(li)Six from the bosses of Bosses' Rise.$(br)$(li)The rest from the Wither, the End, brewing, trading, the trial chambers and other work you are doing anyway.$(br2)Every eye and its source is listed under $(l:eyes/about)The Sixteen Eyes$(n).

pages.title: You Cannot Waste a Boss
pages.text: $(bold)A boss takes no damage from you until the node that asks for it is reachable.$(br2)An eye you have not unlocked still goes in your pack; it just will not go in the portal frame.
